title: On Deserving a better answer than that
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：deserve　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 deserve 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the clerk ① deserved a better answer than that year after year, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② deserves a better answer than that for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ deserve a better answer than that at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ deserved a better answer than that before — a line in the file for May 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Deserving a better answer than that year after year, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ deserve all the praise it got for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Deserve all the praise it got at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ deserves all the praise it got year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ deserved a better answer than that again when nobody else would.

⑩ To deserve a better answer than that, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody deserves a better answer than that for the whole place again and somebody must deserve a better answer than that year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 应得（一般过去式 deserved a better answer than that：1990 年书记员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 应得（一般现在 deserves a better answer than that：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 应得（不定式 to deserve a better answer than that：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 应得（过去完成时 had deserved a better answer than that：1984 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 应得（动名词 deserving a better answer than that 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 值得（deserve all the praise it got：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去值得配得上它得到的称赞）
G. v. 值得（deserve all the praise it got：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 应得（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 deserves all the praise it got，而母亲又一次 deserved a better answer than that）

deserves a better answer than that

answers.why: deserve 意为“应得”，1990 年书记员年年地应得该得到比那更好的答复，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 deserved。
deserve 意为“应得”，自那以后书记员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 deserves。
deserve 意为“应得”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯应得该得到比那更好的答复”，此处为不定式 to deserve a better answer than that。
deserve 意为“应得”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人应得过，故用过去完成时 had deserved。
deserve 意为“应得”，书记员说“应得该得到比那更好的答复这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 deserving a better answer than that 作主语。
deserve 意为“值得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去值得配得上它得到的称赞”，should ever 之后用原形 deserve all the praise it got。
deserve 意为“值得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻值得配得上它得到的称赞（deserve all the praise it got at once），以后再也不要提起。
deserve 意为“应得”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例值得配得上它得到的称赞，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 deserves。
deserve 意为“应得”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地应得该得到比那更好的答复，用一般过去式 deserved 叙述。
deserve 意为“应得”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要应得该得到比那更好的答复，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，书记员年年地应得该得到比那更好的答复；办事处里每一个申请人都说这是头一回。（deserved a better answer than that）
多年以后，书记员仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（deserves a better answer than that）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯应得该得到比那更好的答复这件事本身。（to deserve a better answer than that）
早在 1984 年就有人应得该得到比那更好的答复，五月那天卷宗上的一行字就是证据。（had deserved a better answer than that）
书记员说过，年年地应得该得到比那更好的答复这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（deserving a better answer than that 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻值得配得上它得到的称赞，以后再也不要提起。（deserve all the praise it got，祈使句）

Three months on, the clerk still deserves a better answer than that for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to deserve a better answer than that at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had deserved a better answer than that long before 1997, and the line in the file for May proves it.
Deserving a better answer than that year after year, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 deserve 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the clerk deserved a better answer than that year after year, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk deserves a better answer than that for the whole place whenever the office asks.
Deserving a better answer than that year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever deserve all the praise it got for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office deserves all the praise it got year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother deserved a better answer than that again, and the office remembered that half.
